Name: Simple Crop Label
Author: TheMusketeer
Description:
Adds a tooltip identifying crops and fruit trees.

[color=#6d9eeb][b]New[/b]
[/color]Latest version (6.0.2) for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.13.[/b] Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases/tag/4.1.6]SMAPI 4.1.6[/url] or later.

[color=#6d9eeb][b]How to use[/b]
[/color]Hold right mouse button OR controller A (bottom face) button over crop/fruit tile.
Optionally configure mod to show label on cursor hover, display crop growth/harvest information, and set custom keybinds (see below on how to configure).
Supports splitscreen, Generic Mod Config Menu mod, Custom Bush mod, and Stardew Valley Expanded mod.

[img]http://i.giphy.com/xT1XGS9c67tOSy2ZEc.gif[/img]

[color=#6d9eeb][b]How to install[/b]
[/color]1. Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases/tag/4.1.6]SMAPI 4.1.6[/url]﻿ or later.
2. Download mod.
3. Extract and place folder 'SimpleCropLabel' in your StardewValley/Mods folder.
    [color=#999999]( Stardew Valley > Mods > SimpleCropLabel > manifest.json and SimpleCropLabel.dll )[/color]
4. Launch game using StardewValleyModdingAPI.exe.

See [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]guide[/url] on how to install mods.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]How to configure
[/color][/b]Locate config.json file in the 'SimpleCropLabel' mod folder (run the game once with the mod installed to generate config.json file if not present).
Values below can also be changed in-game using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod.

To hover cursor over crop instead of holding down button to display label
Open the config file in a text editor and modify the "mouse_hover" value from
"mouse_hover": false, [color=#999999](default) hold button to display label[/color]
"mouse_hover": true, [color=#999999](changed) hover cursor to display label[/color]
and save file.

Change custom keybindings
"custom_key": "" [color=#999999](default) uses right mouse button or controller A (bottom face)[/color]
"custom_key": "Z" [color=#999999](changed) to use the "Z" key on the keyboard instead[/color]
Combination of keys can be used, for example, "LeftShift + Z"
OR set multiple bindings, for example, "Z, LeftControl + X"
more key values [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Button_codes]here[/url]

Enable growth/harvest information
"growth_info": false, [color=#999999](default) no growth information[/color]
"growth_info": true, [color=#999999](changed) show crop growth information (see gif below)[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/314/314-1711122262-576120829.gif[/img]
